papers.route: Springer Link VoR article page (HTML, not PDF) rendered in the user's Paseo browser (Electron on the Windows laptop; browserId b8895c52-2e6f-44ab-ac11-5382d63cf881; the tab was already open on the article URL and the page said 'You have full access to this open access article'). Text = document.querySelector('article').innerText, extracted with mcp__paseo__browser_evaluate: SHA-256, character count and word count were computed inside the browser first, then the text was returned in 4 chunks of <=30,000 chars (offsets 0, 30000, 60000, 90000) and reassembled from the worker's transcript JSONL with python3 -I (_scripts/structk25/assemble_from_transcript.py, no retyping). Each chunk SHA-256 and the whole-text SHA-256 equal the browser values. Table bodies are not in article.innerText (only captions + 'Full size table' links), so Tables 1-5 were fetched same-origin from /article/.../tables/1..5 in the same browser (HTTP 200) and saved separately as tables_from_springer_html.txt (own browser SHA-256).
